official_source_url.value: https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/san-marino/entry-requirements — UK government official travel advisory confirms San Marino issues no independent visa: "You can travel without a visa to the Schengen area and San Marino for up to 90 days in any 180-day period." San Marino has an open land border with Italy (a Schengen member) and no separate border control, so entry is governed de facto by Schengen/Italian visa rules rather than a San Marino-specific visa regime. No San Marino-specific photo size/background/format spec exists because there is no separate San Marino visa document.
